findings.claim: The renumber note in ADR-028 enumerates only two of the four review artifacts that still say ADR-027, so a reader starting from a resolution artifact follows a citation that now resolves to a different, live ADR about a different subject.
findings.evidence: specs/decisions/ADR-028-build-identity.md:5-9 names tasks/reviews/pr31-r1.json and pr31-r2.json. But pr31-r1-resolution.json:30 cites 'specs/decisions/ADR-027-build-identity.md §e' and 'prompts/013-s2-build-identity.md' (also :59), and pr31-r2-resolution.json's R12 note says 'Matches ADR-027 §g' — neither is covered by the note. Following those, ADR-027-build-identity.md and 013-s2-build-identity.md are 404s, and plain 'ADR-027' now lands on ADR-027-ambiguity-caps-confidence.md, which has no §e and no §g about build identity. check_index (src/repo_hygiene/eval_adapter.py:70) only pins INDEX<->file one-to-one and cannot see prose citations, so nothing in the gate covers this.
findings.acceptance: The ADR-028 renumber note names all four PR #31 review artifacts (both rounds plus both resolutions) as deliberately pre-renumber, or the resolution artifacts carry the same one-line round-3 annotation the r1-resolution R4 note already demonstrates. Debt row is an acceptable route; nothing executable depends on it.

findings.claim: The R10 fix was applied to one of the two ROOT git oracles in the same function: the `git ls-files` tracked-BUILD_SHA check still inherits the git location variables, so an ambient GIT_DIR can make it answer about a foreign repository.
findings.evidence: src/repo_hygiene/eval_adapter.py:1072-1074 `subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','--',build_id.BUILD_SHA_FILE], cwd=ROOT, ...)` — no env= filter, twelve lines below the identical subprocess at :1057-1060 that the repair just gave one. Measured: with a scratch repo that tracks a file named BUILD_SHA, GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE pointed at it -> 1 failure, 'BUILD_SHA is TRACKED: BUILD_SHA', on a tree where `git ls-files -- BUILD_SHA` is empty here. The inverse direction masks a genuinely tracked BUILD_SHA. Pre-existing, not introduced by this repair; does not surface in the real pre-commit hook, where GIT_DIR points at this repo.
findings.repro: mkdir /tmp/tr && cd /tmp/tr && git init -q . && echo deadbeefcafe > BUILD_SHA && git add -f BUILD_SHA && git -c user.email=a@b.c -c user.name=a commit -qm x; then run check_build_identity with GIT_DIR=/tmp/tr/.git GIT_WORK_TREE=/tmp/tr -> 1 failure
findings.acceptance: The `git ls-files` call takes the same env filter as the HEAD oracle above it, or a debt row records the gap with this measurement. One line; not worth a fourth round on its own.

M11 (_temp_repo forced to None) = exactly 1, naming the skip. Unmutated = 0 under all three environments.

Under an ambient GIT_DIR: unmutated = 0, M8 = 3 -- MORE than the 2 it gives without GIT_DIR, so the assertion now fires against the resolver's error rather than the oracle's. No falsifier traded away: M4/M5/M6/M7/M8/M9 unchanged bare.
